name: Bruce Cuts 1828
designer: Individual engravers unidentified in the specimen
description: Pictorial cuts, framed scenes, animals, tools, heraldry and pointing hands from George Bruce’s 1828 specimen.
observed: 499 distinct complete cuts from unnumbered PDF pages 237–403. The inventory accounts for 816 printed settings, including repeated sheets, links matching designs to existing collection IDs and records unresolved or clipped source impressions.
reconstructed: No invented pictorial content. Native-page crops, isolated-speck cleanup, cubic fitting and font-unit rounding interpret the printed impressions. Descriptive names, tags, Private Use assignments and digital metrics are new project work. Three compatible font drawings use a documented coverage screen to preserve apparent shading within renderer limits; the full-detail master and SVG keep the traced engraving.
